info.title: LaughTrack API
info.description: LaughTrack v1 REST API — comedy shows, clubs, comedians, and favorites.

post.summary: Exchange a session cookie for an access + refresh token pair
post.description: iOS clients call this after completing OAuth via ASWebAuthenticationSession. Returns a short-lived access JWT (15 minutes) plus a long-lived opaque refresh token (30 days). Store both in the keychain separately.

Retry-After.description: Number of seconds the client should wait before retrying.

post.summary: Rotate a refresh token for a new access + refresh pair
post.description: Atomically revokes the submitted refresh token and issues a new access+refresh pair. Revoked, expired, or unknown tokens return 401. No Bearer authentication required — the refresh token itself is the credential.

200.description: New token pair issued; the submitted refresh token is now revoked.

401.description: Refresh token is unknown, revoked, or expired

Retry-After.description: Number of seconds the client should wait before retrying.

post.summary: Revoke every active refresh token for the authenticated user
post.description: Requires a valid Bearer access token. Marks every non-revoked refresh_token row for the caller as revoked. iOS clients should still clear local keychain entries after the call completes.

422.description: Authenticated user has no UserProfile row

Retry-After.description: Number of seconds the client should wait before retrying.

delete.description: Requires a valid Bearer access token. Deletes profile-owned rows before deleting the caller user. User-linked accounts, refresh tokens, and sent notifications are removed by database cascades. iOS clients should clear local keychain entries after a 200 response.

patch.description: Sets the saved ZIP code and nearby search radius used for Near Me. Send null for a field to clear it (the client sends explicit JSON null to clear the saved ZIP / distance).

post.description: Upserts an APNs (iOS) or FCM (Android) device token so the user receives comedian-arrival push notifications. iOS APNs hex tokens are stored lowercased; Android FCM tokens are stored verbatim.

delete.description: Deactivates (soft-deletes) a previously registered device token so the device stops receiving push notifications.

get.summary: Per-day show counts for a date range
get.description:
Returns a map of ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) to the number of shows scheduled on that day. Used to render density dots on the date-picker calendar. Range is capped at 90 days; if `to` exceeds the cap, it is silently clamped server-side.

Optional `comedian` and `club` filters scope the result to dates where the named entity appears in the show lineup (comedian) or hosts the show (club). The two are mutually exclusive — supplying both returns 400. Either may be combined with `zip` + `distance` for an additional geographic narrow.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: 5-digit US ZIP code; required for distance filtering.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to from+89 days.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Radius in miles (1-500, defaults to 25 when zip provided).

parameters.name: comedian
parameters.description: Filter density to dates where this comedian appears in the show lineup. Mutually exclusive with `club`.

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: Filter density to dates hosted by this venue. Mutually exclusive with `comedian`.

200.description: Per-day show counts keyed by YYYY-MM-DD.

Retry-After.description: Number of seconds the client should wait before retrying.

get.summary: Composite home-screen feed (hero + six curated sections)
get.description: Single round-trip replacement for seven per-section calls. Returns hero context (zip/city/state + up to 3 near-you shows) plus arrays for trendingComedians, comediansNearYou, showsTonight, moreNearYou, trendingThisWeek, and popularClubs. Rate limit: 60 req/min anon, 300 req/min authenticated. Cache-Control: private, max-age=60 — response is personalized by session profile zipCode and Vercel geo-IP, so shared CDN caching is disabled.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: Optional 5-digit US zip override. When supplied, beats the signed-in user's profile zipCode for this request — used for anonymous callers or profile-preview.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Radius in miles for zip-scoped recommendations (1-500, default 25).

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived (15-minute) access JWT obtained from POST /auth/token or /auth/refresh

zipCode.description: 5-digit US ZIP code, or null to clear the saved ZIP.

nearbyDistanceMiles.description: Nearby search radius in miles, or null to clear the saved distance.

zipCode.description: Saved profile ZIP code used for Near Me.

nearbyDistanceMiles.description: Saved profile distance in miles used for Near Me.

NotificationPreferenceUpdateRequest.description: At least one of the two toggles must be present; omitted toggles are left unchanged.

emailShowNotifications.description: Whether the user receives email notifications for new shows from saved comedians.

pushShowNotifications.description: Whether the user receives push notifications for new shows from saved comedians.

token.description: APNs hex device token (iOS) or FCM registration token (Android).

id.description: Server id of the stored push-token row.

platform.description: Push platform the token was stored under.

deactivated.description: True if a matching active token was deactivated.

refreshToken.description: Opaque 64-char hex refresh token (30 days). Use against /auth/refresh to mint a new access+refresh pair.
The refresh token previously issued by /auth/token or /auth/refresh.

revoked.description: Number of refresh tokens that were revoked.

comedianOnboardingCompleted.description: Whether comedian onboarding has been completed or skipped.
Whether comedian onboarding has been completed or skipped.

userId.description: Opaque server-issued user identifier (User.id, a CUID). Stable across email/displayName changes — iOS clients pass this to analytics setUserID verbatim. Required: every /v1/me response carries it (TASK-2612 rollout complete).

displayName.description: User-facing display name from OAuth (User.name). May be null if the provider didn't supply one.

avatarUrl.description: Avatar/profile photo URL from OAuth (User.image). May be null.

isAdmin.description: Whether the signed-in user has the admin role (UserProfile.role === "admin"). Drives admin-only UI surfaces such as the show-ID badge on the show-detail header.

emailShowNotifications.description: Whether the signed-in user receives email notifications for new shows from saved comedians.

pushShowNotifications.description: Whether the signed-in user receives push notifications for new shows from saved comedians.

comedianOnboardingCompleted.description: Whether comedian onboarding has been completed or skipped.

zipCode.description: Saved profile ZIP code used for Near Me.

nearbyDistanceMiles.description: Saved profile distance in miles used for Near Me.

notificationsUnreadCount.description: Number of unread notifications (distinct comedian+show events with sentAt newer than the last-seen mark). Drives the profile-button unread badge from the launch-time /me fetch. Optional for rollout-window safety: older API responses may omit it; iOS treats a missing value as 0.

unreadCount.description: Number of unread items in this feed (items with isUnread true).

lastSeenAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the user last opened the notification center; null if never opened.

showId.description: Show id; a single-show entry deep-links here on tap.

subtitle.description: Per-show line, e.g. "The Comedy Store on Tuesday, June 30 at 7:00 pm PDT".

showDate.description: ISO-8601 show date; null if the show row was purged.

comedianImageUrl.description: Avatar image URL, or an empty string when unavailable.

id.description: Stable entry id: the notification group id, or "legacy:{comedianId}:{showId}" for pre-grouping rows.

title.description: Reconstructed headline mirroring the push, e.g. "Taylor Tomlinson has 2 shows near you".

body.description: Single-show subtitle; empty string for a grouped entry (render `shows` instead).

comedianId.description: Primary (soonest-show) comedian UUID; null when unknown.

comedianName.description: Primary comedian display name for the row.

comedianImageUrl.description: Primary comedian avatar URL for the row, or an empty string.

comedians.description: Distinct comedians in the entry, soonest-show first.

shows.description: Shows in the entry, soonest first. A single-show entry has exactly one.

route.description: "favorites" for a grouped entry (tap opens the Favorites tab); null for a single-show entry (tap opens shows[0]).

channels.description: Delivery channels that fired for this entry, e.g. ["push", "email"].

sentAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent delivery in the entry.

isUnread.description: Whether this entry's latest send is newer than the last-seen mark.

HomeCityFilter.description: A selectable comedian home-city option. 'value' is the 'city|state' token to pass back as the homeCity query param; 'label' is the human-readable city; 'count' is the number of matching comedians.

ShowDensityResponse.description: Map of ISO date strings (YYYY-MM-DD) to per-day show counts. Days with no shows are omitted.

ComedianHomeLocation.description: Derived home base for a comedian. Every field is nullable; the whole object is optional so existing clients that do not request it are unaffected.

homeCityFilters.description: Available comedian home-city filter options. Empty when no home-location data qualifies; clients omit the control in that case.

shows.description: Up to 3 shows near the hero zip, for the top-of-home carousel.

comediansNearYou.description: Empty when no zipCode is resolved (no profile zip, no ?zip param, no geo-IP).

moreNearYou.description: Shows near the hero zip beyond the first 3 surfaced in hero.shows.

trendingPodcasts.description: Podcasts featuring local comedians when a hero zip is resolved, otherwise globally popular comedian-owned podcasts.
